# Arcticons artwork

23 unchanged WebP files from revision `90a4343510f35e33421f0a41df5debc29c3604d1` of [Arcticons](https://github.com/Arcticons-Team/Arcticons). Sources and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `assets.json`. The chosen glyph represents the listed app family; Vitreo maps related Android/OEM packages to that family.

Artwork: CC BY-SA 4.0, Arcticons contributors. Vitreo tints the artwork cyan at runtime and places it in original HUD frames. Artwork adaptations remain CC BY-SA 4.0. License and credits ship inside the APK. No Arcticons dashboard/application code is included.
